items.title: I'm struggling with my schoolwork.
items.html:
Whatever your reason, our weekly tuition classes are for you. We’ve found that tuition companies tend to just put enrolled students into whatever class they can, depending on availability and convenience. This often makes the student feel even more behind, as the other students of that class would already be ahead because of previous tuition. If you’re struggling with schoolwork, our first point is to find out why – whether that’s accumulated missed knowledge, school absence, or a teacher which doesn’t benefit your learning style. One of our tutors will then do one-on-one sessions with you until you’re at the level of one of our classes, no matter how long that takes.

Whether you want to get into a top course such as Medicine or Dentistry, or if you’re just a perfectionist, our weekly classes will ensure you get the best scores you possibly can. items.title: How our statistics are calculated
items.html:
A student subject means that students studying multiple subjects are counted multiple times. For example, if we have 3 students, where one of them is studying 2 subjects, then that would be 4 student subjects. Student subjects do not include our exam revision courses, UCAT or medicine interview course.

Recorded ATARs and subject scores are not accounting for maths and sciences bonus points.

Average tutor rating and average course rating are calculated per student, and not per year. For example, if we have 3 ratings in 2020 of 5 and 2 ratings in 2021 of 4/5, we calculate the average using (5+5+5+4+4)/5.

Top preference refers to the course which the student ranked first in their SATAC application. We do not count interstate applications in this statistic.

The statistics for the current year are based on the responses we have received so far from our graduating students, and will continue to be updated.

/about/.html:
Altitutor was founded by a group of tutors, who wanted a better way to do tuition.

We found that individual tutors (including ourselves!) often struggled with providing a complete education for students, while tutoring with larger companies lacked personalised learning. That’s why we developed a teaching model which we believe provides the best of both worlds.

We were also unhappy with how families with less money were often unable to afford tutoring, potentially stopping their children from getting into the courses they want to.

Tutoring is ridiculously lucrative. We know.

Altitutor doesn’t want to be just another tutoring company which makes bucketloads of money. We want to make a real, tangible change in the lives of the students we encounter – and we’re not just saying that. To put our money where our mouth is, our company is completely not-for-profit, meaning all of our revenue goes back into teaching students who can’t afford it.

/about/.title: Fairness and equality
/about/.html: Altitutor is a not-for-profit company with the primary mission to provide education to students who cannot afford it. Our subsidy program allows students who need it to study with us for free or at a reduced cost. Subsidy students receive the same resources and quality of education as any of our other students. Click here to apply for our tuition subsidy program

/about/.title: Transparency
/about/.html: As a parent, we want you to know you're getting exactly what you pay for. That's why we have a booking tool for parents to organise a meeting with their child's tutor(s) at any time during the week, to have a chat about questions or concerns.

Student enjoyment
/about/.html: We want students to enjoy lessons enough that they actually want to come to tutoring. This includes initiatives such as no homework - we're so confident in our teaching programs that for most students, we don't need to set any extra work to do at home. Of course, for students who are motivated enough to WANT to do extra work, we have plenty of additional resources available. We also have free snacks and drinks during lessons 🙂

On top of getting our students to achieve good scores, we aim to build a community of engaged learners, who can help and learn from each other while having fun together.

On our part, this includes initiatives such as getting students to help and teach each other, hiring our students as staff members once they graduate, and end-of-year student parties.

Our past students have made lifelong friends at Altitutor 🙂

/about/.html:
A question we get asked a lot is “why would I choose you over other tuition companies or private tutors?”

As much as we can list the features of our program and try to convince you to choose us, the best way for you to decide is to book a free trial session with us. This gives you the best chance to get a sample of how we teach, and decide whether you would like to continue with us.

That being said, here are our teaching methods:

• 1.5 hour sessions: From our experience 1.5 hour sessions mean students maximise their time learning content without students getting bored.
  • Small class sizes: Our classes only contain students of the same level and learning ability, allowing students to teach and learn from each other.
  • Proven study methods: The methods we use we teach you are the same ones our tutors and past students used to achieve the excellent scores they did.
  • 2 tutor sessions: Group tutoring sessions allow students to not only learn from their own mistakes, but others' as well. By introducing a second tutor, students still receive individual help with any questions they are struggling with during the lesson.
  • Comprehensive resources: All of our resources have already been created for you, so students can do as many practice tests or exams as they need.
Students attend a teaching lesson each week for each subject they study with us, in which we teach them course content ahead of school.

/about/.title: 01. Revision and consolidation
/about/.html: At the beginning of each session, students complete a revision sheet / do flashcards for all of the content they have learned up to that lesson. We do this so students don't have to relearn any of the content before their exams - because they already know it!

/about/.title: 02. Learning ahead
/about/.html: Students are provided with with comprehensive notes and practice questions, and taught the content ahead of their school. This method aims to make learning at school easier, so they can focus on their assessments.

/about/.title: 03. Assessment preparation
/about/.html: Once we finish each topic, we complete a topic test together with the students so they can learn assessment strategies from their tutor. We do a test for every lesson after that until the student feels confident with that topic, and only then will we move on to the next topic.
Our support doesn’t stop when you leave our office. Any student studying with us continues to receive guidance on whatever help they need during the week.

/about/.title: Homework help session
/about/.html: If students need additional help with schoolwork, they can come to our 3-hour homework help class for free! This may include: - Assessment preparation: we can give you even more practice tests for any upcoming assessments you have. - Assignment drafting: one of our tutors can help you write your assignment, or draft an assignment you've already written - Catchup on missed lessons: if you're struggling with a particular concept or need to catch up

/about/.title: 24/7 access to guidance
/about/.html: All of our weekly students get unlimited access to our question helpline, where students can ask tutors questions during the week.​

/about/.title: Online resource access
/about/.html: Our online resources comprehensively cover every aspect of the subject, including notes, video lessons, flashcards, practice questions, tests and exams. All of our students get free access to the online resources for the course(s) they are studying with us.
